limitations: Post-ready delivery is asserted; the startup row remains diagnostic and can be missed.
No ESM/native shared-backend multiple-instance, source/error recovery, OS fullscreen or device acceptance.
Owned canvas cleanup does not prove private GPU/WASM close completion.
Local fixed model assets only; no default remote CDN or licensing acceptance.
Media request abort/cache diagnostics are retained; no page errors or console errors in the passing main/legacy matrix.
